pricing_text: Billing is calculated per second of output video, by resolution. For **360p**, your request will cost **$0.03** per second; for **720p**, **$0.10** per second; for **1080p**, **$0.15** per second; and for **4K**, **$0.30** per second. A 10-second **1080p** clip costs **$1.50**, while the same clip at **360p** costs **$0.30**.
notes: usd للأرخص (360p)؛ الافتراضي في المخطط 720p = $0.10/ث. تنبيه: by_resolution في pricing_parsed بملف fal-launch.json كان خاطئًا — الصحيح من النص: 360p 0.03 / 720p 0.10 / 1080p 0.15 / 4k 0.30. المدة 3–10 ث.
